title: Winter Quarters, Second Watch
description: A reverent American history painting of a general kneeling in prayer in the snow at a winter encampment, hat removed, horse waiting behind him. The moment is treated with complete sincerity and quiet devotion. At a respectful distance Space Ghost stands guard holding a lantern, having brought four more lanterns than the situation requires, and Zorak has fallen through a snowdrift. Blue winter shadows, bare birches, warm lantern light and prayerful stillness.
